> A compact desktop robot that translates invisible software debugging data into physical and emotional interactions. Connected via USB-C, a background PC companion script uses Python's traceback module to catch code failures (like NameErrors or SyntaxErrors) and transmits the data over serial. BUGBOT then uses an expressive top display for digital facial animations, a dedicated chest screen for error/line readouts, and integrated RGB LEDs/buzzers to guide me through fixing my code.
